name: gemini-mcp
description: Generate and edit images with Google Gemini image models (Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro) via natural language prompts

gemini_image_model.title: Gemini Image Model
gemini_image_model.description: Override the default image model (default: gemini-3.1-flash-image)

gemini_output_dir.title: Output Directory
gemini_output_dir.description: Default directory for generated images (default: current working directory)

gemini_input_dir.title: Input Directory
gemini_input_dir.description: Directory to resolve bare input-image filenames against (e.g. an uploads folder)

gemini_timeout_ms.title: Request Timeout (ms)
gemini_timeout_ms.description: Upstream request timeout in ms (default: 60000, or 120000 for 4K output)

tools.name: gemini_list_models
tools.description: List available Gemini image models and the current default

tools.name: gemini_image_generate
tools.description: Generate image(s) from a text prompt

tools.name: gemini_image_edit
tools.description: Edit or compose one or more input images with a text instruction (one-off edits; for a series of edits use gemini_interact)

tools.name: gemini_image_set
tools.description: Generate a master image plus N consistent images referencing it

tools.name: gemini_interact
tools.description: Preferred tool for iterative image refinement: multi-turn generation/editing via the Interactions API — chain the returned interaction_id via previous_interaction_id

tools.name: gemini_video_generate
tools.description: Generate a short video (text→video, image→video, or edit) via the Gemini omni model; written to disk as MP4

tools.name: gemini_music_generate
tools.description: Generate music from a text prompt via a Lyria model (clip or pro); written to disk as MP3/WAV

tools.name: gemini_get_result
tools.description: Fetch an async generation started with async: true, by its job_id
